notes.title: September 2021 "Retro First Friday" Update
notes.content:
In a special Retro First Friday update, new content and documentation have been added to the game!


The game's original intro sequence now plays at game start.
New documentation has been added: a PDF that combines a new Quickstart guide with tips for getting started with a new scan of the game's full manual in English, French, German and Italian. This documentation is accessible to all from the Manual link on the game's store page, as well as in Library view for owners of the game.

notes.title: King's Table - The Legend Of Ragnarok Receives Update
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/54d8f3658b7cd9781908ca9a1485b3953d4107c3.jpg

Odin's blessings!

King's Table has just received an update adding new details and flavor to an already exciting and challenging game!


 The game’s intro sequence now plays at the start of the game.
 A new Quickstart Guide has been added to the game’s documentation.
 A new scan of the original manual has been added to the game’s documentation, which includes text in English, French, German, and Italian.
